design.paired: For each geometry, the same unmodified patch supplies the noise scale and control for four separate additive injections; amplitudes are never accumulated.
design.independence: The 48 trials are paired: 12 background/wavelength geometries times four strengths. Three spectra are from the same star. No independent-binomial or stellar-population inference is authorized.

wavelength_definition: All anchors, centers, patch wavelengths and Gaussian widths are barycentric AIR wavelengths in Angstrom, matching archived WAVE/TUCD1 and SPECSYS. No air-vacuum or observer-frame conversion.
center_definition: Base index is nearest archived WAVE sample to anchor. A tie within 32*float64_epsilon*abs(anchor) Angstrom selects lower index. Patch is original samples base_index-500 through base_index+500 inclusive. Pixel step is the median of its 1000 adjacent wavelength differences; every difference must agree within 1e-8 Angstrom. Injection center equals base wavelength plus phase times that step. Phases 0, 0.25 and 0.5 are assigned in chronological background order. Nearest injection-center index uses the same lower-index roundoff tie rule.
noise_definition: Population standard deviation, numpy.std(ddof=0), of exactly 101 UNMODIFIED flux samples centered on the nearest injection-center index: k-50 through k+50 inclusive, ADU. All 101 must be finite and nonzero, and standard deviation positive. The same pre-injection value scales all four strengths. No ERR column or injected-data scatter is used to set amplitude.
injection_definition: Point-sampled additive Gaussian in reduced 1-D flux: amplitude_factor*unmodified_local_population_std*exp(-0.5*((wave-center)/sigma_gaussian)^2). FWHM=center/115000 Angstrom; sigma_gaussian=FWHM/(2*sqrt(2*ln(2))). No pixel integration, new random noise or modification of existing flux except the additive Gaussian. Continuous peak and actual sampled peak are both saved.
detector_definition: Use frozen harps_detector.analyze_arrays and DETECTOR_CONFIG.json without changes, separately on each original 1001-pixel patch and each injection. Its local continuum and scatter are recomputed for each injected patch, so the Gaussian contributes to detector scatter; injection amplitude still uses the unmodified local population standard deviation.
recovery_definition: Recover only when at least one PRELIMINARY_EMISSION_HIT run has an included pixel at index k-2 through k+2, where k is nearest injection-center index in the patch. For inclusive start s and exclusive end e, distance=max(s-k, k-(e-1), 0); match iff distance<=2. SHORT_RUN and WIDE_RUN never count. Store all threshold runs and matched runs.
control_definition: Run the identical detector once on each unmodified patch and apply the identical center/tolerance criterion. Save control_hit separately. Report both all recovered injected trials and recovered_without_control_hit = recovered AND NOT control_hit; an existing control event is not evidence that an injection created a detectable event.
missing_data_rule: If registered patch, unmodified noise window or searchable center is invalid, retain its four registered rows as NOT_EVALUABLE, with reason and null outcomes. Do not move its wavelength, substitute another spectrum, change width/noise or tune detector. Provenance/hash/frame mismatch or an error after starting trials stops the run and leaves a FAILED receipt.
outputs: per-injection JSON and NPZ including exact injected addition and all detector arrays
interpretation: Limited deterministic recovery audit of a frozen first-stage emission filter on three withheld reduced spectra of one star, twelve wavelength/background geometries and four paired strengths. It is not a detection of lasers, a complete sensitivity/completeness curve, a calibrated false-alarm rate, a raw-data reduction test or a population occurrence constraint. No tuning after viewing results.
execution_authorization: Do not execute until project lead approves this plan/script hash; user permission is already supplied by the project task.
